triage.note: The counterpart PR #21 R1/R2/R3 established, applied to the money locks: a check asserting the real file is clean also passes vacuously once it regresses, so a known-bad fixture has to prove the miss is caught. Four mutations, five failures, exact count — `min_failures` alone is a floor and would let a regressed check that ALSO over-fires report green (PR #21 round-2 R5). Two of the four are the reviewer's own R9 mutations verbatim (`ESCALATION_ENABLED = True`; a `Budget` built from literals, which alone accounts for two failures since both ceilings are checked); the other two are the shapes that would defeat a narrower check — a literal `SERVER_MAX_USD` the operator cannot lower, and a `server_budget()` that is constructed and never called, which would silently give every request `llm.Budget`'s per-DOCUMENT default. `SERVER_MAX_CALLS` is left correctly wired in the fixture so a blanket-failing check overshoots the count rather than reaching it.

provenance: PR #58 round 2, created 2026-08-27 alongside the check it falsifies, per hard rule 2.
